title: Approximate FKG inequalities for phase-bound spin systems, with applications to central limit theorems for exponential random graphs
summary: The Fortuin-Kasteleyn-Ginibre (FKG) inequality is an invaluable tool in monotone spin systems satisfying the FKG lattice condition, which provides positive correlations for all coordinate-wise increasing functions of spins. This inequality has numerous applications and plays an integral role in the proof of various central limit theorems (CLTs), including recent work on ferromagnetic exponential random graph models (ERGMs) wherein a Hamiltonian tilt promotes the presence of small subgraphs like triangles.
